description: This file contains Bitbake recipe override functions written in Python, used to customize build configurations for an embedded Linux SDK environment. It manipulates configuration files, manages build layers, and copies kernel images based on machine overrides.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_prepend
methods.description: Prepares the SDK environment by writing to the 'templateconf.cfg' file if it exists.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_append
methods.description: Removes the 'templateconf.cfg' file if certain machine overrides are present to prevent build issues.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_prepend
methods.description: Adds a generic layer to the build system layers list if specific machine overrides are detected.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_append
methods.description: Modifies configuration files, copies kernel images, and updates build environment variables based on machine overrides.
